tools.name: alexishr_list_employees
tools.description: List employees with work-related fields: name, work email, employee number, department, office, manager, hire and end dates. Personal fields are not returned. API: GET /v1/employee.

tools.name: alexishr_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id with work-related fields only (no SSN, bank account, address or private contact). API: GET /v1/employee/{id}.

tools.name: alexishr_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies in the account (name, organisation number, VAT number, contact details). API: GET /v1/company.

tools.name: alexishr_list_departments
tools.description: List departments with their parent department and cost centre. API: GET /v1/department.

tools.name: alexishr_list_offices
tools.description: List offices with their name, time zone and contact details. API: GET /v1/office.

tools.name: alexishr_list_teams
tools.description: List teams with their name and description. API: GET /v1/team.

tools.name: alexishr_list_cost_centers
tools.description: List cost centres with their code and name. API: GET /v1/cost-center.

tools.name: alexishr_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with their name, code and lead user. API: GET /v1/project.

tools.name: alexishr_list_employment_types
tools.description: List employment types (for example full-time or part-time) with country and vacation settings. API: GET /v1/employment-type.

tools.name: alexishr_list_leave_types
tools.description: List leave types (for example vacation or sick leave) with their kind and paid flag. API: GET /v1/leave-type.

tools.name: alexishr_list_leaves
tools.description: List leave requests (dates, status, duration, type). Filter by employee, leave type, status or start-date range. API: GET /v1/leave.

tools.name: alexishr_get_vacation_balance
tools.description: Get the current vacation balance of one employee: available days, pools and cycle dates. API: GET /v1/vacation-balance/{employeeId}.

tools.name: alexishr_list_vacation_balances
tools.description: List the current vacation balance of every employee that has one, optionally for one employee. API: GET /v1/vacation-balance.

tools.name: alexishr_list_timesheets
tools.description: List timesheets (period, status, approver, submit and approval dates). Filter by employee, status or period start. API: GET /v1/timesheet.

tools.name: alexishr_list_timesheet_entries
tools.description: List time entries (date, minutes, type, project, note). Filter by employee, timesheet, project or date range. API: GET /v1/timesheet-entry.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "alexishr_list_cost_centers" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: alexishr_list_employees · Private data: alexishr_get_employee, alexishr_list_companies, alexishr_list_offices · Public sink: alexishr_list_employees, alexishr_list_timesheets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: alexishr_list_employees · Private data: alexishr_get_employee, alexishr_list_companies, alexishr_list_offices · Public sink: alexishr_list_employees, alexishr_list_timesheets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
